CustomField.description: CHECK: oversold / Out of stock / Low stock / In stock, based on Stock Remaining and Reorder Level. Excel: Stock & Sales column I (Low stock added).
CustomField.formula: IF(Stock_Remaining__c < 0, "CHECK: oversold", IF(Stock_Remaining__c = 0, "Out of stock", IF(Stock_Remaining__c <= BLANKVALUE(Reorder_Level__c, 0), "Low stock", "In stock")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: In stock, Low stock (at or below Reorder Level), Out of stock, or CHECK: oversold (more sold than purchased).
CustomField.label: Stock Status
